llm_response.reason: The website uses DSQUARED2 branding but is labeled Corrie Crouwel, which is not associated with the real DSQUARED2 brand. It displays unusually low prices, enticing urgency/sale offers, and free delivery claims. There is no proper company information, contact details, or payment info, only shopping and cart pages. These are characteristic of fake online shopping scams that spoof reputable brands to solicit payments without delivering goods.
